messages:
sam (Procurement): Hey team — reviewing OptiSpend invoice #OS-2026-04. There's a large line item labeled "trial_credit_proration" for $3,120 and an overage of $2,450. Can someone from billing confirm how trial credits were prorated? Looks off vs our usage.

maria (Finance): @sam can you paste the invoice excerpt? what's the purchase order / contract id? I want to reconcile before we ask them for a credit.

sam (Procurement): PO: PO-99831, contract v2 signed 2025-11-03. Invoice excerpt:
```
Line  | Description                 | Amount
1     | Base subscription (Apr)     | $12,000
2     | Usage overage (Feb-Mar)     | $2,450
3     | trial_credit_proration      | -$3,120
4     | Taxes                       | $1,032
Total |                            | $12,362
```
Not sure why trial_credit_proration > usage spike. @akshay any quick reconcile?

akshay (Billing): Giving a quick look — our usage logs show a one-off spike on 2026-02-20 from 14:35–15:10 UTC. CSV extract:
```
timestamp,model,tokens
2026-02-20T14:35:12Z,inf-cpu-encoder,1240000
2026-02-20T14:36:45Z,inf-gpu-gen,560000
```
But trial credit was 100k token-equivalent (see onboarding). $3.1k in credit seems like they prorated an annual credit? 🤔

vendor-jess (OptiSpend): Hi all — Jess from OptiSpend billing. Sorry for the confusion. Our system prorates trial credits across the first paid invoice after trial end. In this case the trial ended 2026-02-15 but due to plan change it got applied across Apr billing window with a rounding policy that credits by USD cents after currency conversion. I'll re-run the calculation and post line-by-line. In short: we didn't charge twice, the $3,120 is the remaining annual credit portion applied this cycle. Link to our docs: https://optispend.example.com/docs/proration

sam (Procurement): Thanks. Can you share the calc and the original trial credit amount? If the prorated credit is wrong we need a corrected invoice or a manual credit memo. Prefer credit memo for month-end close.

vendor-jess (OptiSpend): Sure. Quick breakdown I'm about to run. Preliminary: original promo = $4,500 annual credit; used during trial period ~ $1,380; remainder $3,120. But we round to nearest dollar after applying FX and tax deferral; I can attach CSV with per-day application by EOD. If you'd like, we can issue a credit memo for the $3,120 and reissue invoice — or apply a negative adjustment next cycle. Which do you prefer? :+1:

lena (Legal): If it's a straightforward math/calc error, credit memo is fine. If it's their intended proration per contract, we need the clause reference. Contract says "trial credits applied to first invoice after trial end unless otherwise agreed." (clause 4.2.1)

maria (Finance): Ok — for speed, we approve a credit memo for up to $500 without escalation. Anything > $500 needs documentation (per contract) and a verifier note from OptiSpend. Please escalate to me if they ask for >$500 clawback.

vendor-jess (OptiSpend): Understood. I'll run the detailed calc and either push a credit memo for $3,120 or, if it's contractual, attach the line-by-line proof. Expect an updated reply by 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC. Thanks — will follow up with CSV and proposed credit memo number. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Invoice OS-2026-04 status changed -> awaiting vendor action (credit memo) — reminder in 72h.

sam (Procurement): Appreciate it. Please tag me when it's posted so we can close PO-99831. :pray:
